angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: City planners are crucial for managing population growth by designing physical structures and systems, such as new transport routes and housing units, to reduce congestion and improve services.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: City planners are crucial for managing population growth by designing physical structures and systems, such as new transport routes and housing units, to reduce congestion and improve services.

angles.label: Point 2
